thresholds.frozen: 2026-09-15, before the D.1b Isaac start. Dr Sun: Kujiale/InteriorAgent route, Terms of Use accepted for this project, 1 download + 1 Isaac start for the stage audit without the model, run beside the vendor isaac-sim container with per-process GPU memory. A run's recorded thresholds must equal this file byte for byte (sha256 checked by the summary).
thresholds.scope: D.1b stage audit only: no robot, no VLA, no ROS. D.1c (Lite3 physical gate) and D.1d (VLA co-residence) need their own authorisation.

unresolved_reported_not_gated: bare *.mdl module names (e.g. OmniPBR.mdl), resolved by Kit's MDL search path
values of info:unreal:sourceAsset: Unreal content paths (/Engine/..., /Game/...) left by the exporter on UnrealShader prims for the unreal render context; Kit renders the info:mdl:sourceAsset shader
stage.unresolved_rule_amended: 2026-09-15, before any download or start: a dry run of the static audit on real kujiale_0021 object files showed 80 info:unreal:sourceAsset Unreal paths per 9 objects that no resolver can resolve

classification.object_rule: every direct child prim of a room Scope under <defaultPrim>/Meshes is one object; class = semantic:Semantics:params:semanticData on the object prim, else the prim name without a trailing _NNNN

collision.method: PhysX overlap_box against the object's world AABB grown by the padding on every side; the object's collider is effective if at least one hit's collision path lies under the object prim

physics.bodies_not_created_by_physx: listed, not a movement failure (a body PhysX never created cannot move; C2 decides whether its collider works); at least one gated body must be found
physics.physx_buffers: one_env preset of scripts/phase_b_camera_probe.py, as in every Phase C/D Isaac run

render.timing_origin: pose A: end of sim.reset() (collider cooking and the first two renders happen inside reset and are recorded as reset_s); pose B: after the cameras are moved

gpu_memory.measure: peak used_memory of this run's own compute process(es), from host nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps sampled every 1 s; processes present before the start (the vendor container) are excluded
gpu_memory.projection: device_peak_D1d = vla_client_peak + isaac_audit_peak + robot_lidar_allowance + device_overhead, with the vendor container gone
gpu_memory.vla_client_peak_source: phase_d_vla_fused_blue_box_v1 samples.csv, InternVLA-N1 client process peak (green/red 17,694)
gpu_memory.device_overhead_source: D.0f device peak 21,899 minus per-process peaks 17,728 + 4,121
gpu_memory.robot_lidar_allowance_source: ASSUMPTION, not measured: the audit has no robot and no LiDAR ray-cast meshes; D.1d measures the real value
gpu_memory.verdicts: PASS <= 5462 (>= 1 GiB projected free); MARGINAL <= 6486 (0-1 GiB projected free, D.1d needs Dr Sun to accept the margin); FAIL > 6486 (co-residence predicted to run out of memory as specified)

host.allowed_foreign_compute_processes: only processes inside the running docker container named isaac-sim (vendor, not ours; never touched)

validity_controls.added: 2026-09-15, before the start, from the independent pre-GPU review (trellis-check); no gate number changed

physics_readout_probe.rule: a 0.1 m, 1 kg dynamic cube spawned at `position` (away from every scene collider) must drop expected_drop_m +- tolerance_m over the settle steps in the readout that P1 uses. P1 reads bodies through an omni.physics.tensors rigid-body view; get_rigidbody_transformation is used only if the view's probe fails and its own probe passes. If no readout's probe passes, P1 FAILS as invalid.
physics_readout_probe.expected_drop_basis: semi-implicit Euler g*dt^2*n(n+1)/2 with g 9.81, dt 0.005, n 200 = 4.930 m (1/2 g t^2 = 4.905 m)

camera_pose_readback.rule: after spawning at pose A and after moving to pose B, every camera's world position from its XformPrimView must lie within max_error_m of the computed target; otherwise that pose's render check FAILS
camera_pose_readback.basis: the constant readback bias seen in D.0f was at most 0.027 m

overlap_subdivision.rule: each object query stops at its first own hit and has no hit cap; if no own hit and the query reported at least trigger_hits hits, the box is split into 8 octants (each padded) and each is queried, down to max_depth; an object with no own hit where a deepest query still reported trigger_hits or more is listed as inconclusive and counted as not effective

floor_ray.rule: raycast_all with both triangle sides: passes if any hit belongs to a floor-class object (case-insensitive) with hit z within floor_hit_z_tolerance_m; the closest hit and the closest front-face hit are recorded

thresholds.verdict_rule: D.1b ADMITS the scene to D.1c when every stage, collision, physics and render check passes and GPU memory is PASS or MARGINAL; any FAIL is recorded with the failing objects or frames, and nothing further runs without Dr Sun
